hook.title: I gave my *Raspberry Pi* a face
hook.cover: I gave my Pi a face

scenes.title: Ignore it 10 min and it *falls asleep*

end.title: Meet *Wisp*
end.sub: play with it in your browser · link in bio

caption:
Every voice assistant is a speaker with a light on it. I wanted mine to have a face.

This is Wisp. Six states: idle, listening, thinking, speaking, happy, sleepy. Runs fullscreen on a 5" screen on a Raspberry Pi 5 at 30 fps, and every state is a real seamless loop.

You can play with it in your browser, link in bio. Which state is your favorite?
